name: LP333 ID5 phase-seeded Kissat from audited weighted record 4128
hypothesis: Mapping Kissat's forced primary phases to the independently audited campaign-record objective-4128 ID5 endpoint may reach a directly verified SAT model where the default, 8256, 5280, and 4512 phase arms did not.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second Kissat 4.0.4 run at seed 0 on the exact ID5 CNF after the SHA-256-pinned 114-variable literal renaming derived from the audited objective-4128 endpoint, with phase true, forcephase true, and rephase false
claim_boundary: Only a complete transformed model satisfying the renamed CNF, inverse-decoding to a model of the original CNF, and independently verifying both full rows plus all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations decides ID5. UNKNOWN and proofless UNSAT decide nothing.

baseline.evidence: The source endpoint independently passes every weighted-objective, full-PAF, subgroup, forced-margin, source, binary, and mutation check.
baseline.measurement: The endpoint has squared residual 4128, L1 residual 672, and maximum residual 12. The renamed formula preserves all 218018 variables and 1366261 clauses.

intervention.one_change: Use the audited objective-4128 endpoint as the exact 114-variable literal-renaming map while retaining the original clauses, auxiliaries, Kissat phase policy, seed, and resource cap.

controls.expected: Formula SHA-256 8715e45501126432d4a7fb4f17e5d10508b4295ba33aab90be0eb00f7a56f955 preserves 218018 variables and 1366261 clauses, and the independent stream audit passes.

controls.name: sat-positive-control
controls.purpose: Show the pinned solver returns and serializes a complete SAT model.
controls.expected: Before the target, Kissat solves the pinned profile-cell fixture and its complete model satisfies every fixture clause.

controls.name: bidirectional-model-check
controls.expected: Any SAT model satisfies the transformed CNF, inverse-decodes to the original CNF, and passes the independent full ID5 verifier.

primary_metric.name: directly verified SAT model for fixed family ID5

terminal_outcomes.promote: Kissat returns SAT and transformed-CNF, inverse-renaming, original-CNF, and direct LP333 audits all pass.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen run returns no SAT model; preserve UNKNOWN or proofless UNSAT as nondecisive.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any formula, mapping, tool, control, transformed model, decoded model, original CNF, or direct ID5 check fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned transformed formula at seed 0 with phase true, forcephase true, and rephase false.
Use exactly the independently audited objective-4128 heuristic.
Stop immediately after a directly verified SAT model.
Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without another phase policy, seed, heuristic, or cap.
Do not promote UNKNOWN, proofless UNSAT, or an unaudited SAT marker.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, construct H668, independently verify orthogonality and hashes, and package the gated submission artifact.
next_actions.park: Archive the arm and move to exact partial-spectrum coset DFS rather than another phase or seed.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interruption and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest formula-map, decoder, runner, or verifier defect.

authority.data_scope: Local source-pinned formulas, binaries, public prompt artifacts, and generated results are authorized.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
